- **Shiva as Kalantaka conquers Death for Markandeya** — When Yama casts his noose around the boy clinging to a Shiva-linga, Shiva bursts forth as Kalantaka/Mrtyunjaya, strikes down Death, and blesses Markandeya to remain eternally sixteen and deathless _(actors: Markandeya, Shiva (Kalantaka/Mrtyunjaya), Yama)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/markandeya.md) — (Shiva Purana; Linga Purana)
- **Sudarshana Chakra beheads Rahu** — Vishnu's time-disc the Sudarshana Chakra (Kala-chakra) beheads the demon Rahu who stole the amrita, the weapon-face of Time cutting off every form at its appointed moment _(actors: Vishnu, Rahu)_ → [details](00-time-and-cosmology/kalachakra-wheel-of-time.md) — (Mahabharata; Bhagavata Purana; Vishnu Purana)
- **Rishabhadeva avatara born to Nabhi and Merudevi** — Vishnu descends as Rishabha, son of King Nabhi and Merudevi of the Priyavrata line, an avatara of Narayana who fathers a hundred sons, the eldest being Bharata _(actors: Rishabhadeva, Nabhi, Merudevi, Jayanti)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishabha-bharata-jada.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 5.3-5.4; Vishnu Purana 2.1)
- **Rishabha's renunciation and death by forest fire** — After delivering the Rishabha-gita to his sons and crowning Bharata, Rishabha wanders as a naked avadhuta and quits his body, consumed by a wildfire, absorbed in the Self _(actors: Rishabhadeva, Bharata)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishabha-bharata-jada.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 5.5-5.6)
- **Emperor Bharata's reign and renunciation** — Bharata rules Bharata-varsha righteously while inwardly detached, then divides the empire among his sons and retires to Pulaha-ashrama on the Gandaki to meditate _(actors: Bharata, Panchajani)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishabha-bharata-jada.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 5.7)
- **Bharata's attachment to the deer and rebirth as a deer** — The ascetic Bharata becomes attached to an orphaned fawn he rescues; dying with the deer in his mind, he is reborn as a conscious deer remembering his past life _(actors: Bharata, the fawn/deer)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishabha-bharata-jada.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 5.8)
- **Jada Bharata the silent sage and the Rahugana teachings** — Reborn as a brahmana, the soul feigns idiocy as Jada Bharata, is nearly sacrificed to Bhadra Kali (who saves him), then teaches King Rahugana the forest-of-samsara allegory and attains liberation _(actors: Jada Bharata, King Rahugana, Bhadra Kali)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishabha-bharata-jada.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 5.9-5.14)
- **Satya Yuga — the Age of Truth** — Dharma stands on all four legs; humans live ~100,000 years in spontaneous righteousness, with meditation as the path to liberation _(actors: humanity)_ → [details](00-time-and-cosmology/yugas-and-mahayuga.md) — (Vishnu Purana 1.3, Bhagavata Purana 12.3)
- **Soma emerges from the churning of the ocean** — In the Samudra Manthana the Moon (Soma/Chandra) emerges among the fourteen ratnas and is taken by Shiva onto his head, fusing the soma-as-nectar and soma-as-moon ideas _(actors: Soma/Chandra, Shiva, devas and asuras)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/chandra-soma.md) — (Bhagavata, Vishnu, Matsya Puranas)
- **Kapila born to Kardama and Devahuti** — Kapila, an avatara of Viṣṇu and founder-sage of Sankhya, is born to the Prajapati Kardama and Devahuti to impart self-knowledge to his mother _(actors: Kapila, Kardama, Devahuti)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/darshanas/samkhya-karika.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 3.24-33)
- **Matsya rescues Manu and the Vedas from the deluge** — Vishnu as the fish Matsya warns Manu of the coming pralaya, has him build a boat loaded with the seeds of life and the seven sages, tows it through the flood, and (in variants) slays the demon Hayagriva to restore the stolen Vedas — marking the start of our Manvantara _(actors: Matsya (Vishnu), Manu, the saptarshi, Hayagriva)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/dashavatara.md) — (Shatapatha Brahmana 1.8.1; Matsya Purana; Bhagavata Purana 8.24)
- **Kurma supports Mount Mandara at the churning** — As devas and asuras churn the ocean of milk for amrita using Mount Mandara and the serpent Vasuki, the sinking mountain is supported on the back of Vishnu as the giant tortoise Kurma _(actors: Kurma (Vishnu), devas, asuras, Vasuki)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/dashavatara.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 8.7-8; Vishnu Purana 1.9; Mahabharata Adi Parva)
- **Dhanvantari and Mohini emerge at the churning** — During the Samudra Manthana the physician-god Dhanvantari emerges bearing the nectar pot, and Vishnu takes the Mohini form to trick the asuras out of the amrita _(actors: Dhanvantari, Mohini (Vishnu), devas, asuras)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/dashavatara.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 8; Vishnu Purana)
- **Narasimha slays Hiranyakashipu and saves Prahlada** — To evade the demon-king Hiranyakashipu's boon, Vishnu bursts from a pillar as the man-lion Narasimha at twilight on a threshold, and disembowels him with his claws while saving his devotee-son Prahlada _(actors: Narasimha (Vishnu), Hiranyakashipu, Prahlada)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/dashavatara.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 7.2-10; Vishnu Purana 1.16-20)
- **Rahu beheaded at the churning** — At the Samudra Manthana the asura Rahu steals the amrita and is beheaded by Vishnu as Mohini, becoming the eclipse-node _(actors: Rahu, Mohini (Vishnu))_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/devas-asuras-and-the-lokas.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 8; Vishnu Purana)
- **Exile of the Daityas and Danavas** — In Krita/Satya Yuga the Daityas and Danavas are exiled from heaven by the devas and take refuge in the Vindhya mountains and the sea (Patala) _(actors: Daityas, Danavas, the devas)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/devas-asuras-and-the-lokas.md) — (Puranas)

## Tretā Yuga  ·  601 events

*Dharma on three legs. Vāmana, Paraśurāma, and the Rāmāyaṇa.*

- **Śatrughna Slays Lavaṇāsura and Founds Mathurā** — Mathurā is said to be founded where Śatrughna, Rāma's brother, slays the asura Lavaṇa, son of Madhu, bridging the Rāmāyaṇa and Kṛṣṇa eras _(actors: Śatrughna, Lavaṇāsura)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/mathura-vrindavan-braj.md) — (Ramayana, Uttara-kanda; Vishnu Purana)
- **Bali's Conquest of the Three Worlds** — Revived and empowered by Śukra and the Bhṛgus, the Asura king Bali storms Svarga and dispossesses Indra, becoming sovereign of all three worlds _(actors: Bali, Śukrācārya, Indra, Devas, Bhṛgu brahmins)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vamana-bali.md) — (Bhāgavata Purāṇa 8.15)
- **Birth of Hanuman to Anjana and Vayu** — Hanuman is born to the apsara-turned-vanari Anjana and the vanara chief Kesari, conceived through the agency of Vayu, making him Vayuputra _(actors: Hanuman, Anjana, Kesari, Vayu)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/hanuman.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Kishkindha Kanda 66; Uttara Kanda 35-36)
- **Birth of Lakṣmaṇa and the pāyasa division** — From Daśaratha's putrakāmeṣṭi sacrifice a divine being yields sacred pāyasa; Sumitrā's two half-portions produce the twins Lakṣmaṇa and Śatrughna, Lakṣmaṇa attaching to Rāma _(actors: Daśaratha, Sumitrā, Lakṣmaṇa, Śatrughna)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/lakshmana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Bāla-kāṇḍa)
- **Birth of Māndhātā from His Father's Body** — The Ikṣvāku cakravartin Māndhātā is born from his father's body after the king drank consecrated fertility-water, and is suckled by Indra _(actors: Māndhātā, Yuvanāśva, Indra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/minor-upakhyanas-catalog.md) — (Mahabharata Vana & Drona Parvas; Bhagavata 9; Vishnu Purana)
- **Birth of Rāvaṇa and his siblings** — Approaching Viśravas at an inauspicious twilight, Kaikasī bears the ten-headed Rāvaṇa (marked by ill omens), Kumbhakarṇa, the righteous Vibhīṣaṇa, and Śūrpaṇakhā _(actors: Viśravas, Kaikasī, Rāvaṇa, Kumbhakarṇa, Vibhīṣaṇa, Śūrpaṇakhā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/ravana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Uttara-kāṇḍa)
- **Birth of Sītā from the furrow** — Ploughing a sacrificial field, King Janaka turns up an infant girl in the furrow and adopts her as Sītā, an ayonijā born of the Earth-goddess _(actors: Janaka, Sītā, Bhūmi)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/sita.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Bāla Kāṇḍa)
- **Birth of the Shloka Meter (Valmiki's Curse)** — Grieving a hunter's killing of a mating krauncha bird, Valmiki utters a curse that spontaneously takes metrical form, birthing the shloka (shoka to shloka) — the meter of Sanskrit epic _(actors: Valmiki, the hunter, krauncha birds)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/README.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda 2)
- **Birth of Vālī and Sugrīva from Ṛkṣaraja** — The vānara lord Ṛkṣaraja is transformed into a woman; Indra's seed on his hair begets Vālī and Sūrya's on his nape begets Sugrīva _(actors: Ṛkṣaraja, Indra, Sūrya, Vālī, Sugrīva)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/sugriva-and-vali.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Uttara-kāṇḍa)
- **Birth of Ṛśyaśṛṅga from a doe** — Vibhāṇḍaka's seed is swallowed by a doe, who bears a single-horned boy raised in total isolation, ignorant of women, his chastity amassing great tapas _(actors: Vibhāṇḍaka, the doe, Ṛśyaśṛṅga)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishyashringa.md) — (Mahābhārata Vana Parva ~110)
- **Daśaratha resolves to crown Rāma yuvarāja** — The aged Daśaratha resolves to install Rāma as crown prince while he lives; the assembly acclaims the choice and the rite is rushed under Puṣya nakṣatra _(actors: Daśaratha, Rāma, Vasiṣṭha)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/2-ayodhya-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Ayodhyā Kāṇḍa 1–4)
- **Descent of the Gaṅgā at Gaṅgā-dvāra** — The Gaṅgā debouches from the Himalaya onto the plain at Haridwar, the gateway by which the goddess first enters the world of men, linked to Bhagīratha's bringing-down of the river _(actors: Gaṅgā, Bhagīratha)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/haridwar-rishikesh-ganga-dwara.md) — (Mahabharata, Vana Parva)
- **Ganga springs from Vishnu's foot (Vamana)** — When Vamana's raised step pierces the cosmic shell, the Causal Ocean pours in and washes his foot, becoming the Ganga, hence Vishnupadi _(actors: Ganga, Vamana/Vishnu)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/ganga.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 5.17)
- **Hanumān meets Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa** — Sent by the anxious Sugrīva, Hanumān approaches the brothers disguised as a mendicant, is reassured of their good faith, and carries them on his shoulders to Sugrīva _(actors: Hanumān, Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa, Sugrīva)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/4-kishkindha-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Kiṣkindhā Kāṇḍa 3–4)
- **Hanumān's leap across the ocean** — From Mount Mahendra Hanumān launches a hundred-yojana leap across the southern ocean toward Laṅkā _(actors: Hanumān)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/5-sundara-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Sundara Kāṇḍa 1)
- **Hariścandra's vow to Varuṇa and Rohita's birth** — Childless Hariścandra vows to sacrifice his firstborn to Varuṇa; a son Rohita is born, but the king endlessly postpones the offering _(actors: Hariścandra, Varuṇa, Rohita, Nārada)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/sunahshepa.md) — (Aitareya Brāhmaṇa 7.13-14)
- **Harishchandra's vow to Varuna for a son** — Childless King Harishchandra prays to Varuna and vows to sacrifice his promised son; Varuna grants the boon and Rohita is born _(actors: Harishchandra, Varuna, Rohita, Narada)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/sunahshepa.md) — (Aitareya Brahmana 7.13-14)
- **Śibi and the dove — the flesh-offering** — Indra (hawk) and Agni (dove) test King Śibi, who protects the refugee dove by offering his own flesh equal to its weight, finally his whole body _(actors: Śibi, Indra, Agni)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/shibi.md) — (Mahābhārata Vana Parva ~130-131)
- **Kauśika's hospitality at Vasiṣṭha's hermitage** — King Kauśika, resting with his army, is feasted entirely by Vasiṣṭha's wish-cow Śabalā/Kāmadhenu, igniting his covetousness for it _(actors: Viśvāmitra (Kauśika), Vasiṣṭha)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vishwamitra-vasishtha.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa 51-53)
- **Kāmadhenu conflict — the spark** — King Kauśika tries to seize Vasiṣṭha's wish-cow Śabalā/Nandinī by force after the sage refuses to sell her _(actors: Viśvāmitra (Kauśika), Vasiṣṭha, Śabalā/Nandinī)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vishwamitra-vasishtha.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa 51-55; Mahābhārata)
- **Nahuṣa installed as Indra** — After Indra flees the sin of slaying Vṛtra, the gods elect the virtuous mortal emperor Nahuṣa to the vacant throne of heaven, augmenting his tapas _(actors: Nahuṣa, Indra, the devas, ṛṣis)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/nahusha.md) — (Mahābhārata Udyoga Parva 11-12; Bhāgavata 6.13)
- **Paraśurāma Fills Five Lakes with Kṣatriya Blood** — Between Tretā and Dvāpara, Paraśurāma in his twenty-one exterminations of the kṣatriyas fills five lakes at Samanta-pañcaka with their blood and offers tarpaṇa, naming the field _(actors: Paraśurāma)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/kurukshetra-dharmakshetra.md) — (Mahabharata, Adi-parva 2)
- **Purūravas born of Budha and Ilā** — Purūravas is born to Budha (son of the Moon) and Ilā, Manu's gender-shifting child, grafting Manu's line onto the Moon's at the hinge of the Lunar dynasty _(actors: Purūravas, Budha, Ilā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/pururavas-urvashi.md) — (Bhagavata Purana IX.1, IX.14; Vishnu Purana IV.1, IV.6)
- **Rāma singles out the Māṇḍūkya for Hanumān** — In the Muktikā dialogue Rāma instructs Hanumān on a graded path of Upaniṣadic study, declaring 'the Māṇḍūkya alone is enough for the liberation of the seeker.' _(actors: Rāma, Hanumān)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/upanishads/mandukya-upanishad.md) — (Muktikā Upaniṣad 1.26–29)
- **Rāma threatens the ocean and Setu is built** — When the sea-lord refuses passage to Laṅkā, Rāma readies the brahmāstra; Varuṇa appears, submits, and advises building Rāma Setu with Nala's help _(actors: Rāma, Varuṇa/Samudra, Nala)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/varuna.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Yuddha Kāṇḍa)
- **Satyavrata commits the three sins** — As a wild prince Satyavrata angers his father, abducts a bride, and kills and eats Vasishtha's sacred cow, for which Vasishtha curses and names him Trishanku _(actors: Satyavrata, Trayyaruna, Vasishtha)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/trishanku.md) — (Harivamsha; Puranic)
- **Slander of Sītā in Ayodhyā** — A washerman's grumble about taking back a wife who lived in another man's house becomes public censure (loka-apavāda) that Rāma the king cannot ignore _(actors: Rāma's spies, citizens, the washerman)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/uttara-ramayana-lava-kusha.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Uttara Kāṇḍa 43-45)
- **Slaying of Virādha** — The rākṣasa Virādha seizes Sītā; the brothers bury him alive, and dying he reverts to the gandharva Tumburu, released by Rāma's touch _(actors: Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa, Virādha)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/3-aranya-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Araṇya Kāṇḍa 2–4)
- **The wager over Hariścandra's truthfulness** — Vasiṣṭha praises Hariścandra as the most truthful king; Viśvāmitra disputes it and undertakes to break him, with the king as the stake _(actors: Vasiṣṭha, Viśvāmitra, Hariścandra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/hariscandra.md) — (Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa 7; Devī Bhāgavata Purāṇa 7)
- **Trishanku's three sins and curse-naming** — Prince Satyavrata angers his father, abducts a bride, and kills Vasiṣṭha's cow, earning the curse-name Triśaṅku from the sage _(actors: Satyavrata/Triśaṅku, Vasiṣṭha, Trayyāruṇa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/trishanku.md) — (Harivaṃśa; Purāṇas)
- **Urvaśī weds Purūravas under three conditions** — The apsarā Urvaśī marries the first Lunar king Purūravas on conditions including that she never see him naked _(actors: Purūravas, Urvaśī)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/pururavas-urvashi.md) — (Ṛgveda X.95; Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa XI.5.1; Viṣṇu Purāṇa IV.6)
- **Vamana avatara & subduing of Bali** — Vishnu as a dwarf brahmana begs three paces from asura-king Bali, grows cosmic (Trivikrama), and pushes Bali to Patala _(actors: Vamana/Vishnu, Bali, Kashyapa, Aditi)_ → [details](01-manvantaras/manvantara-07-vaivasvata/mahayuga-28-current/02-treta-yuga.md) — (Bhagavata Purana, Vishnu Purana, Vamana Purana)
- **Vamana Subdues Bali (Boon of Future Indra-hood)** — Vishnu as Vamana reclaims the three worlds from the daitya king Bali in three strides, pushing him to Patala/Sutala but granting that Bali will become Indra in the future Savarni manvantara as recompense for his truthfulness _(actors: Vishnu; Vamana; Bali; Virochana)_ → [details](01-manvantaras/manvantara-08-savarni.md) — (Vishnu Purana 3.2; Bhagavata Purana 8.13.15, 8.22-23)
- **Vamana subdues Bali (Trivikrama)** — Vishnu, born as the dwarf brahmana Vamana, begs three paces of land from the asura-king Bali, then grows cosmic (Trivikrama), covers earth and heaven in two strides, and sets his third foot on Bali's head pushing him to rule Patala _(actors: Vamana/Vishnu, Bali, Kashyapa, Aditi)_ → [details](01-manvantaras/manvantara-07-vaivasvata/mahayuga-28-current/02-treta-yuga.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 8.15-23; Vishnu Purana; Vamana Purana)
- **Varuṇa grants Hariścandra a son to be sacrificed** — Counselled by Nārada, the sonless Hariścandra prays to Varuṇa, who grants him a son, Rohita, on condition the boy be sacrificed back to Varuṇa _(actors: Hariścandra, Varuṇa, Nārada, Rohita)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/hariscandra.md) — (Aitareya Brāhmaṇa 7.13–14)
- **Vibhīṣaṇa defects to Rāma** — Spurned by Rāvaṇa for urging Sītā's return, Vibhīṣaṇa surrenders to Rāma, who rules that a refuge-seeker must never be turned away and pre-crowns him king of Laṅkā _(actors: Vibhīṣaṇa, Rāma, Rāvaṇa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/6-yuddha-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Yuddha Kāṇḍa 17–19)
- **Vibhīṣaṇa's tapas and boon of righteousness** — In joint austerities at Gokarṇa, Vibhīṣaṇa alone asks that his mind never stray from dharma; pleased, Brahmā additionally grants him immortality _(actors: Vibhīṣaṇa, Brahmā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/vibhishana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Uttara Kāṇḍa)
- **Vibhandaka sheds his seed and the doe conceives Rishyashringa** — The ascetic Vibhandaka, overcome at a lake, involuntarily sheds his seed; a doe (a cursed apsaras) drinks it and conceives, bearing a boy and being freed of her curse _(actors: Vibhandaka, the doe-apsaras, Urvashi)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishyashringa.md) — (Mahabharata, Vana-parva ~110)
- **Vālmīki composes the first śloka** — Grief at seeing a hunter kill a krauñca bird bursts from Vālmīki as the first anuṣṭubh verse (śoka becoming śloka), birthing Sanskrit poetry _(actors: Vālmīki)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/smriti-itihasa-epics.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa)
- **Vālmīki witnesses the krauñca bird's death and utters the first śloka** — Grieving a hunter's killing of a mating curlew, Vālmīki's sorrow bursts out as metrical verse, birthing the anuṣṭubh meter and poetry itself _(actors: Vālmīki)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/1-bala-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Bāla Kāṇḍa 2)
- **Vāyu fathers Hanumān upon Añjanā** — Vāyu fathers Hanumān upon the apsarā-turned-vānarī Añjanā by his wind-agency, making Hanumān Vāyuputra/Pavanaputra _(actors: Vāyu, Añjanā, Hanumān)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/vayu.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Kiṣkindhā 66, Uttara 35-36)
- **Aditi's Payovrata** — Grieving for her dispossessed sons, Aditi performs the twelve-day Payovrata milk-vow on Kaśyapa's instruction; Viṣṇu promises to be born as her son _(actors: Aditi, Kaśyapa, Viṣṇu)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vamana-bali.md) — (Bhāgavata Purāṇa 8.16–8.17)
- **Śarabhaṅga's self-immolation** — Having gained Rāma's darśana, the sage Śarabhaṅga enters the fire and ascends in a radiant body to Brahmaloka _(actors: Śarabhaṅga, Rāma)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/3-aranya-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Araṇya Kāṇḍa 5)
- **Avatara of Mayureshvara** — Ganesha descends in Treta Yuga as the peacock-mounted Mayureshvara and slays the demon Sindhu(rasura); his Morgaon form heads the Ashtavinayaka shrines _(actors: Ganesha (Mayureshvara), Sindhurasura)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/puranas/ganesha-and-mudgala-upapuranas.md) — (Ganesha Purana (Krida-khanda))
- **Birth of Rāma at Ayodhyā** — Rama, the seventh avatar of Vishnu, is born at Ayodhya on the Sarayu in the Treta Yuga _(actors: Rama)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/sapta-puri-and-sacred-cities.md) — (Garuda Purana; Valmiki Ramayana)
- **Birth of the horned Rishyashringa** — Because of his doe-mother the child is born with a single horn on his forehead, hence Rishyashringa, and is raised in total forest isolation ignorant of women _(actors: Rishyashringa, Vibhandaka)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishyashringa.md) — (Mahabharata, Vana-parva ~110-111)
- **Brahma Commissions the Ramayana** — Brahma appears to Valmiki and commissions him to compose the story of Rama, establishing the adi-kavya (first poem) _(actors: Brahma, Valmiki)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/README.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda 2)
- **Brahmā commissions Vālmīki to compose the Rāmāyaṇa** — Brahmā commands Vālmīki to compose Rāma's life in the new meter, granting divine insight into every event _(actors: Brahmā, Vālmīki)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/1-bala-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Bāla Kāṇḍa 2)
- **Building of the Setu (Rāma-Setu)** — After Rāma's penance compels the ocean-god Sāgara, the vānara Nala directs the building of a hundred-yojana floating causeway in five days, and the army crosses to Laṅkā _(actors: Rāma, Nala, Sāgara)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/6-yuddha-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Yuddha Kāṇḍa 21–22)
- **Courtesans lure Ṛśyaśṛṅga to end Aṅga's drought** — King Lomapāda sends courtesans disguised as ascetics to lure the chaste sage to Aṅga; his arrival breaks the years-long drought with rain _(actors: Ṛśyaśṛṅga, Lomapāda, the courtesans, Indra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishyashringa.md) — (Mahābhārata Vana Parva ~111-112)
- **Descent of Vishnu as Rama** — In the standard avatar-to-yuga mapping of this Mahayuga, Vishnu descends as Rama in the Treta Yuga _(actors: Vishnu; Rama)_ → [details](01-manvantaras/manvantara-07-vaivasvata/mahayuga-28-current/README.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 1.3; Valmiki Ramayana)
- **Gālava's Horses and Mādhavī's Loaning** — Pressed for 800 special horses as guru-dakṣiṇā, Gālava loans Yayāti's daughter Mādhavī to three kings and Viśvāmitra to earn sons and horses, the debt finally closed by Garuḍa _(actors: Gālava, Viśvāmitra, Mādhavī, Yayāti, Aṣṭaka)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/minor-upakhyanas-catalog.md) — (Mahabharata Udyoga Parva 105-121)
- **Hanumān passes Maināka and outwits Surasā** — On the crossing Hanumān courteously refuses the rest offered by the golden mountain Maināka and outwits the nāga-mother Surasā's mouth-test of strength and wit _(actors: Hanumān, Maināka, Surasā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/5-sundara-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Sundara Kāṇḍa 1)
- **Hariścandra surrenders his kingdom** — To appease Viśvāmitra, Hariścandra gives away Ayodhyā and all its wealth, keeping only his wife, son, and bark-cloth, then owes a further gold dakṣiṇā _(actors: Hariścandra, Viśvāmitra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/hariscandra.md) — (Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa 7-8)
- **Harishchandra defers the sacrifice and Varuna curses him with dropsy** — Harishchandra repeatedly postpones offering Rohita; for the broken vow Varuna seizes him with dropsy, and the grown Rohita flees to the forest _(actors: Harishchandra, Varuna, Rohita)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/sunahshepa.md) — (Aitareya Brahmana 7.14)
- **Indra strikes the infant Hanuman's jaw** — Mistaking the sun for a fruit, infant Hanuman leaps to swallow it; Indra strikes him with the vajra, breaking his jaw and giving him his name _(actors: Hanuman, Indra, the sun)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/hanuman.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Uttara Kanda; Ramcharitmanas)
- **Kapila's Wrath Burns Sagara's Sons** — Sage Kapila's wrath burns Sagara's 60,000 sons to ash, the catastrophe that prompts the eventual descent of Gaṅgā to redeem them; his ashrama tradition is localized at Haridwar _(actors: Kapila, sons of Sagara)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/haridwar-rishikesh-ganga-dwara.md) — (Wikipedia, Haridwar)
- **Lakṣmaṇa weds Ūrmilā (fourfold wedding)** — At Mithilā, alongside Rāma's wedding to Sītā, Lakṣmaṇa weds Ūrmilā in a fourfold marriage binding Ayodhyā and Mithilā _(actors: Lakṣmaṇa, Ūrmilā, Rāma, Sītā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/lakshmana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Bāla-kāṇḍa)
- **Mantharā poisons Kaikeyī's mind** — The hunchback maid Mantharā convinces Kaikeyī that Rāma's coronation will ruin her and Bharata, coaching her to invoke the two old boons _(actors: Mantharā, Kaikeyī)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/2-ayodhya-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Ayodhyā Kāṇḍa 7–11)
- **Nahuṣa's pride and lust for Śacī** — Corrupted by heaven's splendour, Nahuṣa covets Indra's queen Śacī, who stalls him by demanding he arrive in a palanquin borne by the Saptarṣis _(actors: Nahuṣa, Śacī, Bṛhaspati)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/nahusha.md) — (Mahābhārata Udyoga Parva 13-17)
- **Parashurama avatara & Kartavirya Arjuna** — Vishnu as the brahmana-warrior Parashurama slays the thousand-armed king Kartavirya Arjuna who seized the wish-cow Kamadhenu _(actors: Parashurama, Jamadagni, Renuka, Kartavirya Arjuna)_ → [details](01-manvantaras/manvantara-07-vaivasvata/mahayuga-28-current/02-treta-yuga.md) — (Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana, Vishnu Purana)
- **Parashurama slays Kartavirya Arjuna** — The thousand-armed Haihaya king Kartavirya Arjuna seizes the wish-cow Kamadhenu from Jamadagni's hermitage, and Parashurama slays him; in revenge Kartavirya's sons kill the unarmed Jamadagni _(actors: Parashurama, Kartavirya Arjuna, Jamadagni, Kamadhenu)_ → [details](01-manvantaras/manvantara-07-vaivasvata/mahayuga-28-current/02-treta-yuga.md) — (Mahabharata; Bhagavata Purana 9.15-16)
- **Purūravas founds the Lunar dynasty at Pratiṣṭhāna** — Purūravas performs penance to Brahmā, gains sovereignty, and becomes the first king of the Candravaṃśa, ruling from Pratiṣṭhāna (Prayāga) _(actors: Purūravas, Brahmā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/pururavas-urvashi.md) — (Vishnu Purana IV.6; Bhagavata Purana IX.14)
- **Rāma breaks Śiva's bow and wins Sītā** — At Mithilā's bow-test Rāma lifts and snaps the colossal divine bow of Śiva, winning Sītā's hand; the four princes wed in one ceremony _(actors: Rāma, Sītā, Janaka, Viśvāmitra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/sita.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Bāla Kāṇḍa)
- **Rohita flees and Indra's 'caraiveti' refrain** — Told he must die, Rohita flees to the forest for years while Indra, disguised, repeatedly urges him to keep wandering _(actors: Rohita, Indra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/sunahshepa.md) — (Aitareya Brāhmaṇa 7.14-15)
- **Rohita flees and Varuṇa curses Hariścandra** — Told he is to die, Rohita escapes to the forest and wanders six years urged on by Indra ('caraiveti'), while Varuṇa afflicts the king with dropsy for the broken vow _(actors: Rohita, Indra, Varuṇa, Hariścandra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/hariscandra.md) — (Aitareya Brāhmaṇa 7.14–15)
- **Rāvaṇa's Austerities at Rākṣas-tāl** — The rākṣasa king Rāvaṇa performs severe austerities at Rākṣas-tāl, offering his ten heads to Śiva to win boons, naming the lake Rāvaṇa-hrada _(actors: Rāvaṇa, Śiva)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/manasarovar-kailash-yatra.md) — (folk / sthala tradition; Valmiki Ramayana Uttara-kanda)
- **Rāvaṇa's tapas and Brahmā's boon** — After fierce penance, Rāvaṇa offers his heads one by one into the fire; Brahmā stops him and grants invulnerability to all celestial and demonic beings — but, in contempt, Rāvaṇa omits men and animals _(actors: Rāvaṇa, Brahmā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/ravana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Uttara-kāṇḍa)
- **Satyavrata's charity during the twelve-year famine** — The exiled prince sustains Viśvāmitra's starving family by hunting, freeing the son Gālava from being sold; the sage repays with gratitude _(actors: Satyavrata, Viśvāmitra's family, Gālava)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/trishanku.md) — (Harivaṃśa)
- **The cow's army routs Kauśika** — Śabalā/Nandinī snorts forth armies of foreign peoples who defeat Kauśika's forces, and the sage's brahmadaṇḍa swallows every weapon _(actors: Vasiṣṭha, Śabalā, Kauśika)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vishwamitra-vasishtha.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa 54-56)
- **The fire-witnessed friendship-pact of Rāma and Sugrīva** — Rāma and Sugrīva swear mutual aid with Agni as witness — Rāma to slay Vāli and restore Sugrīva, Sugrīva to mobilize the vānaras to find Sītā _(actors: Rāma, Sugrīva, Hanumān)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/4-kishkindha-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Kiṣkindhā Kāṇḍa 5)
- **The gandharvas' trick breaks the condition; Urvaśī departs** — Gandharvas steal Urvaśī's rams; Purūravas leaps up naked, a lightning-flash exposes him, and Urvaśī vanishes _(actors: Purūravas, Urvaśī, the gandharvas)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/pururavas-urvashi.md) — (Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa XI.5.1; Viṣṇu Purāṇa IV.6)
- **The gods' revelation and boon to Śibi** — Indra and Agni reveal themselves, heal Śibi's wounds, declare his fame imperishable, and promise him a son Kapotaroma _(actors: Śibi, Indra, Agni, Kapotaroma)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/shibi.md) — (Mahābhārata Vana Parva)
- **The wish-cow's army routs Kauśika** — Refused the cow and trying to seize her by force, Kauśika is routed when the cow snorts forth armies of foreign peoples and his hundred sons are burnt to ash _(actors: Kauśika, Vasiṣṭha, Śabalā/Nandinī)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vishwamitra-vasishtha.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa 53-55)
- **Trishanku's charity during the twelve-year famine** — During a twelve-year famine the exiled Satyavrata hunts to feed Vishvamitra's destitute family and frees the son Galava from being sold, earning the sage's gratitude _(actors: Satyavrata, Vishvamitra, Galava)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/trishanku.md) — (Harivamsha)
- **Vamana grants Bali immortality and rule of Patala** — Vishnu as Vamana presses Bali to Patala in three strides but, moved by his truthfulness, grants him rulership of Sutala, immortality, and guards his door _(actors: Vamana, Bali)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/the-chiranjivis.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 8.15-23; Vamana Purana)
- **Vibhīṣaṇa spurned in Rāvaṇa's court** — Counseling the return of Sītā and warning of ruin, Vibhīṣaṇa is enraged-spurned and insulted by Rāvaṇa in open court, driving the final break _(actors: Vibhīṣaṇa, Rāvaṇa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/vibhishana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Yuddha Kāṇḍa)
- **Vālī kills Dundubhi and earns Mātaṅga's curse** — Vālī slays the buffalo-demon Dundubhi and hurls the carcass onto Mātaṅga's hermitage, earning a curse that his head will burst if he sets foot on Ṛṣyamūka _(actors: Vālī, Dundubhi, Mātaṅga)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/sugriva-and-vali.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Kiṣkindhā-kāṇḍa)
- **Vāyu withdraws air at Hanumān's striking down** — When the infant Hanumān is struck down by Indra's vajra, the grieving Vāyu withdraws all air from the worlds, suffocating creation until the gods revive Hanumān and grant him boons _(actors: Vāyu, Hanumān, Indra)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/vayu.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Uttara Kāṇḍa 36; Śiva Purāṇa)
- **Aṅgada's embassy to Rāvaṇa** — Rāma sends Vāli's son Aṅgada as envoy demanding Sītā's release; Rāvaṇa orders him seized, but Aṅgada shakes off the guards and departs defiantly _(actors: Aṅgada, Rāvaṇa, Rāma)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/6-yuddha-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Yuddha Kāṇḍa 41)
- **Agastya's curse turns Nahuṣa into a python** — Yoking the Saptarṣis and kicking Agastya while crying 'sarpa', Nahuṣa is cursed by the sage to fall from heaven as a python _(actors: Nahuṣa, Agastya, the Saptarṣis)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/nahusha.md) — (Mahābhārata Udyoga Parva 17; Vana Parva 178)
- **Ajīgarta sells and binds his son Sunaḥśepa** — Rohita buys the middle son Sunaḥśepa for a hundred cows as a substitute victim; the father Ajīgarta agrees to bind and butcher his own child for more cattle _(actors: Rohita, Sunaḥśepa, Ajīgarta)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/sunahshepa.md) — (Aitareya Brāhmaṇa 7.15-16)
- **Birth of Rama at Ayodhya** — After Dasharatha's putra-kameshti sacrifice, Rama and his brothers are born at Ayodhya on Rama Navami, the seventh avatara of Vishnu descending into Suryavamsha flesh _(actors: Dasharatha, Rama, Vasishtha)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/ayodhya.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Bala-kanda)
- **Birth of Rama via Putra-kameshti Sacrifice** — Dasharatha performs the putra-kameshti (son-desiring) sacrifice, resulting in the birth of Rama and his brothers — the avatara-descent of Vishnu _(actors: Dasharatha, Rama)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/README.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda)
- **Birth of Vāmana** — Viṣṇu is born to Aditi and Kaśyapa as the dwarf-brahmin Vāmana, fifth of the Daśāvatāra, and undergoes upanayana receiving staff, deerskin and water-pot _(actors: Vāmana (Viṣṇu), Aditi, Kaśyapa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vamana-bali.md) — (Bhāgavata Purāṇa 8.18; Vāmana Purāṇa)
- **Daśaratha performs the Putrakāmeṣṭi sacrifice** — The childless Ikṣvāku king Daśaratha, on Vasiṣṭha's counsel, has the sage Ṛśyaśṛṅga conduct the son-desiring oblation after an Aśvamedha _(actors: Daśaratha, Ṛśyaśṛṅga, Vasiṣṭha)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/1-bala-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Bāla Kāṇḍa 13–16)
- **Drought strikes Anga after Lomapada's offence** — Indra withholds rain from Anga because King Lomapada sinned against a brahmana; the brahmins counsel that only the chaste ascetic Rishyashringa can break the drought _(actors: Lomapada, Indra, Anga brahmins)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishyashringa.md) — (Mahabharata, Vana-parva ~111)
- **Hanuman and the mermaid Suvannamaccha** — A pan-Southeast-Asian non-Valmiki episode in which the mermaid princess Suvannamaccha tries to sabotage the bridge to Lanka but is won over by Hanuman and bears him a fish-tailed son, Macchanu _(actors: Hanuman, Suvannamaccha (Sovanna Maccha), Macchanu)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/recensions/southeast-asian-ramayanas.md) — (Ramakien; Reamker)
- **Hanumān kills Siṃhikā** — The shadow-seizing sea-monster Siṃhikā drags Hanumān down; he plunges into her, rends her organs from within, kills her, and flies on _(actors: Hanumān, Siṃhikā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/5-sundara-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Sundara Kāṇḍa 1)
- **Hariścandra sells his family and himself** — To pay the fee, Hariścandra sells queen Śaivyā and son Rohitāśva into bondage and sells himself to a Cāṇḍāla running the Kāśī cremation ground _(actors: Hariścandra, Śaivyā/Candramatī, Rohitāśva, the Cāṇḍāla (Yama))_ → [details](04-deep-dives/hariscandra.md) — (Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa 8)
- **Śibi gives away his eyes (Jātaka)** — In the Buddhist Sibi Jātaka, Sakka disguised as a blind brāhmaṇa begs an eye; Sivi gives both, and his sight is restored by an Act of Truth _(actors: Śibi/Sivi, Sakka)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/shibi.md) — (Sibi Jātaka no. 499; Jātakamālā 2)
- **Indra's caraiveti refrain keeps Rohita wandering** — Five times Indra appears as a brahmin urging the wandering Rohita onward with the verse 'keep wandering.' _(actors: Indra, Rohita)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/sunahshepa.md) — (Aitareya Brahmana 7.15)
- **Institution of Navarātri; Rāma's Navarātri-pūjā** — The Devī Bhāgavata institutes Navarātri and recounts Rāma performing the Navarātri-pūjā to win the Goddess's aid _(actors: the Goddess, Rāma)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/puranas/devi-bhagavata-upapurana.md) — (Devī Bhāgavata, skandha III)
- **Kaikeyī demands Bharata's crowning and Rāma's exile** — Binding Daśaratha to his oath, Kaikeyī claims her two boons: Bharata consecrated king and Rāma exiled to the Daṇḍaka forest for fourteen years _(actors: Kaikeyī, Daśaratha)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/2-ayodhya-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Ayodhyā Kāṇḍa 10–13)
- **Kauśika abandons kingship for tapas** — Humiliated by brahman-power, Kauśika renounces his kingdom to pursue ascetic ascent toward brahmarṣi status _(actors: Viśvāmitra (Kauśika))_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vishwamitra-vasishtha.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa 56)
- **Kubera rules golden Lanka** — Kubera first rules the golden island-city of Lanka, built for him by Vishvakarma as the wealth-god's seat _(actors: Kubera, Vishvakarma)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/kubera.md) — (Ramayana)
- **Kumbhakarṇa's boon of endless sleep** — Sarasvatī twists Kumbhakarṇa's tongue so he asks for sleep instead of a world without gods, dooming him to sleep six months and wake one day _(actors: Kumbhakarṇa, Sarasvatī, Brahmā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/ravana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Uttara-kāṇḍa)
- **Lakṣmaṇa insists on accompanying Rāma into exile** — When Kaikeyī's boons force Rāma into exile, Lakṣmaṇa first urges seizing the throne, then vows to accompany Rāma as servant and guard _(actors: Lakṣmaṇa, Rāma, Sītā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/lakshmana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Ayodhyā-kāṇḍa)
- **Marriage of Ṛśyaśṛṅga and Śāntā** — The grateful Lomapāda weds his daughter Śāntā to Ṛśyaśṛṅga, turning the forest-celibate into a householder _(actors: Ṛśyaśṛṅga, Śāntā, Lomapāda)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishyashringa.md) — (Mahābhārata Vana Parva ~113)
- **Parashurama's twenty-one-fold kshatriya annihilation** — Enraged at his father's murder, Parashurama vows to rid the earth of the kshatriya class twenty-one times, filling five lakes at Samanta-panchaka with their blood _(actors: Parashurama, the kshatriyas)_ → [details](01-manvantaras/manvantara-07-vaivasvata/mahayuga-28-current/02-treta-yuga.md) — (Mahabharata Vana/Shanti Parvan; Bhagavata Purana 9.16)
- **Purchase of Śunaḥśepa as sacrificial substitute** — Rohita buys the middle son Śunaḥśepa from the starving ṛṣi Ajīgarta for a hundred cows to be sacrificed in his place, and Ajīgarta agrees for further cows to bind and butcher his own son _(actors: Rohita, Śunaḥśepa, Ajīgarta)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/hariscandra.md) — (Aitareya Brāhmaṇa 7.16)
- **Purūravas becomes a gandharva by the fire-ritual** — Grieving Purūravas wins the gandharvas' fire-boon, establishes the three sacred fires via the śamī-aśvattha araṇi, and ascends to the gandharva-world; son Āyu continues the line _(actors: Purūravas, Urvaśī, Āyu)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/pururavas-urvashi.md) — (Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa XI.5.1; Bhāgavata IX.14)
- **Rāma pierces the seven sāla trees** — To prove his prowess to a doubtful Sugrīva, Rāma kicks Dundubhi's skeleton ten yojanas and shoots a single arrow through seven sāla trees _(actors: Rāma, Sugrīva)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/4-kishkindha-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Kiṣkindhā Kāṇḍa 11–12)
- **Rāma's Jala-samādhi into the Sarayū** — At the close of his reign Rama makes his final departure by walking into the Sarayu river, the anchoring event of Ayodhya's sanctity _(actors: Rama)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/sapta-puri-and-sacred-cities.md) — (Garuda Purana; Valmiki Ramayana)
- **Rāma slays Tāṭakā and guards Viśvāmitra's sacrifice** — Sage Viśvāmitra takes the young Rāma to kill the demoness Tāṭakā and protect the sages' sacrifices _(actors: Rāma, Viśvāmitra, Tāṭakā)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/smriti-itihasa-epics.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa 1 (Bāla Kāṇḍa))
- **Rāma vows to clear Daṇḍaka of demons** — Shown the bones of ascetics devoured by rākṣasas, Rāma vows to rid the Daṇḍaka forest of demons, the dharmic pledge driving the kāṇḍa _(actors: Rāma)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/3-aranya-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Araṇya Kāṇḍa 6)
- **Sagara's horse-sacrifice and Indra's theft** — Emperor Sagara performs an Ashvamedha; Indra, fearing his power, steals the sacrificial horse and hides it at sage Kapila's hermitage in Patala _(actors: Sagara, Indra, Kapila)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/ganga.md) — (Ramayana, Bala Kanda 38-40)
- **Sita and Rama bless Hanuman with deathlessness** — Sita blesses Hanuman with deathlessness and eternal youth and Rama decrees he shall live as long as the Rama-katha is told on earth _(actors: Sita, Rama, Hanuman)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/the-chiranjivis.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana)
- **Sita's Agni-pariksha and Return to the Earth** — Sita, daughter of the earth and King Janaka, abducted by Ravana, undergoes the fire-ordeal and finally returns into the earth _(actors: Sita, Rama, Janaka)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/README.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana)
- **Sita's curse on the Phalgu river** — A Ramayana-linked legend holds Sita cursed the Phalgu river at Gaya to run underground, a story tied to the ancestral pinda-offering circuit _(actors: Sita)_ → [details](05-concepts-and-dharma/shraddha-and-pitr-rites.md) — (Ramayana-linked tradition)
- **Sītā insists on accompanying Rāma into exile** — When Kaikeyī's boon sends Rāma into forest exile, Sītā refuses palace comfort and insists a wife's place is at her husband's side _(actors: Sītā, Rāma)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/sita.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Ayodhyā Kāṇḍa)
- **The brahmadaṇḍa swallows Kauśika's astras** — Kauśika hurls Śiva-given astras including the brahmāstra at the hermitage, but Vasiṣṭha's brahmin staff swallows them all, teaching him brahman-strength is supreme _(actors: Kauśika, Vasiṣṭha)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vishwamitra-vasishtha.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa 55-56)
- **The cave, the sealing, and Vālī's usurpation** — Pursuing Māyāvī into a cave, Vālī is sealed in by Sugrīva who believes him dead; returning enraged, Vālī banishes Sugrīva, seizes his kingdom, and takes his wife Rumā _(actors: Vālī, Sugrīva, Māyāvī, Rumā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/sugriva-and-vali.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Kiṣkindhā-kāṇḍa)
- **The gods revive Hanuman and grant boons** — After Vayu withdraws all air in wrath, the devas revive Hanuman and each grants a boon of invulnerability, strength, and longevity, making him effectively immortal _(actors: Hanuman, Vayu, Indra, Brahma, the devas)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/hanuman.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Uttara Kanda 36; Shiva Purana)
- **Triśaṅku's wish and Vasiṣṭha's refusal** — King Triśaṅku asks to ascend bodily to heaven; Vasiṣṭha refuses as adharma, and the sage's sons curse him to become a cāṇḍāla _(actors: Triśaṅku, Vasiṣṭha, Vasiṣṭha's sons)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/trishanku.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa 57-59)
- **Twenty-one-fold kshatriya annihilation** — Enraged at his father's murder, Parashurama rids the earth of the kshatriya class twenty-one times, filling lakes at Kurukshetra _(actors: Parashurama)_ → [details](01-manvantaras/manvantara-07-vaivasvata/mahayuga-28-current/02-treta-yuga.md) — (Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana)
- **Urvaśī cursed to dwell among mortals** — The apsarā Urvaśī is sent to earth by a curse (of Mitra or Mitra-Varuṇa), occasioning her marriage to Purūravas _(actors: Urvaśī, Mitra, Varuṇa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/pururavas-urvashi.md) — (Vishnu Purana IV.6; Bhagavata Purana IX.14)
- **Vasishtha refuses the bodily-ascent wish** — Trishanku desires to ascend to Indra's heaven in his living body, but his purohita Vasishtha refuses the rite as impossible and against dharma _(actors: Trishanku, Vasishtha)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/trishanku.md) — (Ramayana Bala Kanda 57)
- **Vibhīṣaṇa's śaraṇāgati and refuge with Rāma** — Rejected by Rāvaṇa, Vibhīṣaṇa surrenders to Rāma, who vows to never reject one who seeks refuge and at once consecrates him future king of Laṅkā _(actors: Vibhīṣaṇa, Rāma, Hanumān, Sugrīva)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/vibhishana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Yuddha Kāṇḍa 17-19)
- **Viśvāmitra rises from kṣatriya to brāhmaṇa by tapas** — The kṣatriya sage Viśvāmitra attains brahminhood through austerity, adduced by Bhīṣma to show varṇa can be transcended by conduct _(actors: Viśvāmitra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/mahabharata/13-anushasana-parva.md) — (Mahabharata 13)
- **Vālmīki shelters Sītā** — The sage Vālmīki, knowing Sītā by ascetic insight, takes the abandoned queen into his āśrama _(actors: Vālmīki, Sītā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/uttara-ramayana-lava-kusha.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Uttara Kāṇḍa 49)
- **Adhyātma Rāmāyaṇa — Rāma as Brahman with Māyā-Sītā** — The embedded Advaita Rāmāyaṇa retells Rāma's life as supreme Brahman with Sītā as Yoga-Māyā; a shadow Māyā-Sītā is abducted by Rāvaṇa while the real Sītā is hidden in fire _(actors: Rāma, Sītā, Lakṣmaṇa, Rāvaṇa)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/puranas/brahmanda-purana.md) — (Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa (Adhyātma Rāmāyaṇa))
- **Agastya bestows the bow of Viṣṇu on Rāma** — The great sage Agastya gives Rāma the Viṣṇu-bow, inexhaustible quivers, a sword, and a divine arrow, and directs him to settle at Pañcavaṭī _(actors: Agastya, Rāma)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/3-aranya-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Araṇya Kāṇḍa 12–13)
- **Agastya digests the asura Vātāpi** — Agastya eats the goat-disguised Vātāpi and commands 'Be digested', dissolving the cannibal demon, then reduces his brother Ilvala to ash _(actors: Agastya, Vātāpi, Ilvala)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/agastya.md) — (Mahābhārata Vana Parva)
- **Ajigarta sells his middle son Sunahshepa** — Rohita buys the starving rishi Ajigarta's middle son Sunahshepa for a hundred cows to die in his place as the sacrificial victim _(actors: Rohita, Ajigarta, Sunahshepa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/sunahshepa.md) — (Aitareya Brahmana 7.15)
- **Anasūyā gifts Sītā celestial garments** — Visiting sages' hermitages during the forest exile, Sītā receives celestial garments and unguents from Anasūyā at Atri's āśrama _(actors: Sītā, Anasūyā, Atri)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/sita.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Ayodhyā/Araṇya Kāṇḍa)
- **Bali's Aśvamedha and the Boon of Three Paces** — At Bali's horse-sacrifice on the Narmadā, Vāmana asks only for three paces of land measured by his own steps, declining all greater gifts _(actors: Vāmana, Bali, Bhṛgu priests)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vamana-bali.md) — (Bhāgavata Purāṇa 8.18–8.19)
- **Ballal's Devotion and the Boon at Pali** — In the Treta Yuga the boy Ballal, beaten and bound by his father for worshipping a stone as Ganesha, is freed and blessed by Ganesha, who grants that his devotee's name precede the Lord's as Ballaleshwar _(actors: Ballal, Kalyan-seth, Ganesha)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/ashtavinayaka.md) — (Ganesha Purana)
- **Courtesans lure Rishyashringa to Anga and the rains fall** — Courtesans on a floating hermitage-barge approach the innocent Rishyashringa as fellow ascetics and entice him to Anga; the moment he enters, Indra sends torrential rain _(actors: Rishyashringa, the courtesans, Indra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishyashringa.md) — (Mahabharata, Vana-parva ~111-112)
- **Hanuman Leaps to Lanka** — The vanara minister Hanuman, son of Vayu, leaps across the ocean to Lanka in the Sundara Kanda _(actors: Hanuman)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/README.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Sundara Kanda)
- **Hanuman struck by Indra's vajra and granted boons as a child** — As a child Hanuman is struck down by Indra's vajra for leaping at the sun, and the devas each grant boons making him invulnerable _(actors: Hanuman, Indra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/the-chiranjivis.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana)
- **Hanumān fells Laṅkinī at the gate** — The city's guardian goddess Laṅkinī challenges Hanumān; he fells her with a single blow, and she recalls the prophecy that her defeat means the rākṣasas' doom _(actors: Hanumān, Laṅkinī)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/5-sundara-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Sundara Kāṇḍa 3)
- **Indrajit binds Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa with nāga-arrows** — Fighting invisibly, Indrajit binds Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa with serpent-arrows so that both fall as if slain, until Garuḍa descends and dissolves the bonds _(actors: Indrajit, Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa, Garuḍa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/6-yuddha-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Yuddha Kāṇḍa 44–50)
- **Jatayu's Cremation at Tirupullam Bhoothankudi** — The Ramayana site where Valvil Raman (Rama) performs the cremation of the vulture Jatayu, slain by Ravana while defending Sita _(actors: Rama, Jatayu)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/108-divya-desams.md) — (Ramayana / sthala-purana)
- **Kaikeyi's Two Boons and Rama's Exile** — At Ayodhya Kaikeyi invokes her two boons, sending Rama into 14-year exile while Bharata rules as regent from Nandigrama with Rama's sandals on the throne _(actors: Kaikeyi, Rama, Bharata)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/ayodhya.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Ayodhya-kanda)
- **Kapila burns Sagara's 60,000 sons to ash** — Sagara's 60,000 sons accuse the meditating Kapila of the theft, and he incinerates all of them to ash with his ascetic fire _(actors: Kapila, the sons of Sagara)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/ganga.md) — (Ramayana, Bala Kanda 40-41)
- **Kauśika renounces kingship for tapas** — Humiliated, Kauśika abandons his kingdom to pursue tapas, the hinge that launches his multi-life quest for brahmarṣi status _(actors: Viśvāmitra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vishwamitra-vasishtha.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa 56)
- **Lakshmi incarnates as Sita with Rama** — When Vishnu descends as Rama, Lakshmi incarnates as Sita, born of the earth-furrow, his consort _(actors: Lakshmi (Sita), Rama)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/lakshmi.md) — (Vishnu Purana 1.9; Ramayana)
- **Marriage of Purūravas and Urvaśī under three conditions** — Urvaśī weds Purūravas on conditions (protect her two rams, never be seen naked, fed only ghee), the kernel of the oldest narrated Indian romance _(actors: Purūravas, Urvaśī)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/pururavas-urvashi.md) — (Rgveda X.95; Shatapatha Brahmana XI.5.1; Vishnu Purana IV.6)
- **Parashurama beheads and restores Renuka** — At Jamadagni's command Parashurama beheads his own mother Renuka for a lapse of mind, then asks a boon to restore her to life _(actors: Parashurama, Renuka, Jamadagni)_ → [details](01-manvantaras/manvantara-07-vaivasvata/mahayuga-28-current/02-treta-yuga.md) — (Mahabharata; Bhagavata Purana)
- **Phra Ram orders Sida's death over a drawn portrait** — In Rama I's Ramakien a rakshasa tricks Sida into drawing Tosakanth's portrait, triggering Phra Ram's suspicion and an order for her death, which he later repents _(actors: Phra Ram, Nang Sida, a rakshasa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/recensions/southeast-asian-ramayanas.md) — (Ramakien)
- **Rama Installs the Rameswaram Linga** — Rama installs the Ramanatha linga at Rameswaram to expiate the sin of killing the brahmin Ravana, making it both a Char Dham point and a Jyotirlinga _(actors: Rama)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/char-dham-and-chota-char-dham.md) — (Skanda Purana; Ramayana tradition)
- **Rama Protects Vishvamitra's Yajna** — The boy-sages Rama and Lakshmana guard Vishvamitra's sacrifice, slaying the rakshasas who would defile it _(actors: Rama, Lakshmana, Vishvamitra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/README.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda)
- **Rama's Ashvamedha, Lava-Kusha, and Sita's earth-return** — The Padma Purana's Pataala-khanda Rama narration frames Rama-Sita as Vishnu-Lakshmi and recounts Rama's Ashvamedha, the Lava-Kusha episode, and Sita's return to the earth _(actors: Rama, Sita, Lava, Kusha)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/puranas/padma-purana.md) — (Padma Purana (Pataala Khanda))
- **Ravana usurps Lanka from Kubera** — After his own austerities and boons, Ravana drives his half-brother Kubera out and seizes Lanka, making it the rakshasa capital _(actors: Ravana, Kubera)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/kubera.md) — (Ramayana)
- **Renuka's beheading and restoration** — At Jamadagni's command Parashurama beheads his own mother Renuka, then wins a boon to restore her to life _(actors: Parashurama, Renuka, Jamadagni)_ → [details](01-manvantaras/manvantara-07-vaivasvata/mahayuga-28-current/02-treta-yuga.md) — (Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana)
- **Rāma accepts exile** — Bound by his father's word as dharma, Rāma serenely accepts the fourteen-year exile without anger toward Kaikeyī or Daśaratha _(actors: Rāma, Kaikeyī)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/2-ayodhya-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Ayodhyā Kāṇḍa 16–19)
- **Rāma slays Vāli** — During Sugrīva's rematch with Vāli, Rāma shoots Vāli from concealment; the dying Vāli rebukes Rāma's stealth, hears his tenfold justification, and commends Aṅgada and Tārā to his care _(actors: Rāma, Vāli, Sugrīva)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/4-kishkindha-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Kiṣkindhā Kāṇḍa 16–18)
- **Rāma's Visit to the Prayāga Akṣayavaṭ** — Rama, Sita and Lakshmana visit the imperishable banyan at Prayaga during their exile, near sage Bharadvaja's ashram _(actors: Rama, Sita, Lakshmana)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/prayagraj-triveni-sangam.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana (Ayodhya-kanda))
- **Rāvaṇa seizes Laṅkā from Kubera and takes the Puṣpaka** — Rāvaṇa defeats and expels his half-brother Kubera from golden Laṅkā and carries off the flying chariot Puṣpaka as his signature vehicle _(actors: Rāvaṇa, Kubera)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/ravana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Uttara-kāṇḍa)
- **Sages curse Hanuman to forget his powers** — For tormenting sages as a child, Hanuman is cursed to forget his own immense powers until reminded at the destined moment _(actors: Hanuman, the sages)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/hanuman.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Kishkindha/Sundara Kanda)
- **Sunaḥśepa freed by his hymns** — Bound to the stake, Sunaḥśepa prays in Ṛgvedic verses to Varuṇa, Uṣas and others; his bonds fall away and Hariścandra is cured of dropsy _(actors: Sunaḥśepa, Varuṇa, Uṣas)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/sunahshepa.md) — (Aitareya Brāhmaṇa 7.16-18; Ṛgveda 1.24-30)
- **The agni-sākṣi pact of Rāma and Sugrīva** — With fire as witness Rāma swears to kill Vālī and restore Sugrīva's throne, while Sugrīva vows to marshal the vānaras to find Sītā _(actors: Rāma, Sugrīva, Hanumān)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/sugriva-and-vali.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Kiṣkindhā-kāṇḍa)
- **The boon of sleeplessness and Ūrmilā-nidrā** — Lakṣmaṇa begs the goddess Nidrā to stay awake for the fourteen years; she consents on condition someone sleep his share, and Ūrmilā sleeps continuously throughout _(actors: Lakṣmaṇa, Nidrā, Ūrmilā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/lakshmana.md) — (folk/devotional; Gupta's Sāket)
- **The dead son and the cremation-fee test** — Rohitāśva dies of snakebite; at the pyre Hariścandra, bound by duty, demands the cremation fee from his own grieving wife _(actors: Hariścandra, Śaivyā, Rohitāśva)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/hariscandra.md) — (Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa 8)
- **The Putrakāmeṣṭi and birth of Rāma and his brothers** — Ṛśyaśṛṅga performs Daśaratha's son-desiring sacrifice; the divine pāyasa given to the queens produces Rāma, Bharata, Lakṣmaṇa and Śatrughna _(actors: Ṛśyaśṛṅga, Daśaratha, the queens, Rāma)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishyashringa.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa ~13-18)
- **Trivikrama Measures the Worlds (Ulagaḷanta form)** — Viṣṇu as Vāmana/Trivikrama strides the cosmos with raised foot, the deed enshrined in the Ulagaḷanta Perumāḷ temple of Kāñcī _(actors: Viṣṇu (Vāmana/Trivikrama))_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/kanchipuram-city-of-temples.md) — (divyadesam.com)
- **Śunaḥśepa's self-rescue by hymn** — Bound to the stake, Śunaḥśepa prays in turn to the gods and his bonds fall away of themselves while Hariścandra is simultaneously cured of his illness _(actors: Śunaḥśepa, Hariścandra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/hariscandra.md) — (Aitareya Brāhmaṇa 7.16–17)
- **Vasishtha's sons curse Trishanku to chandala** — Insulted that he spurned their father, Vasishtha's hundred sons curse Trishanku to become a chandala and his form is instantly disfigured _(actors: Trishanku, Vasishtha's sons)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/trishanku.md) — (Ramayana Bala Kanda 58-59)
- **Vibhīṣaṇa reveals the secret of Rāvaṇa's death** — When Rāma's arrows fail, Vibhīṣaṇa discloses that amṛta stored in Rāvaṇa's navel must be dried up, prompting Rāma to loose the brahmāstra there _(actors: Vibhīṣaṇa, Rāma, Rāvaṇa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/vibhishana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Yuddha Kāṇḍa)
- **Viṣṇu agrees to incarnate as Daśaratha's sons** — The gods, oppressed by the boon-protected Rāvaṇa, petition Viṣṇu, who agrees to be born as Daśaratha's sons to slay Rāvaṇa as a mortal _(actors: Devas, Brahmā, Viṣṇu)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/1-bala-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Bāla Kāṇḍa 14–15)
- **Viśvāmitra's yajña and the curse of the boycotting sages** — Viśvāmitra undertakes Triśaṅku's heaven-rite and curses Vasiṣṭha's sons and Mahodaya, who refuse to attend, to become outcastes _(actors: Viśvāmitra, Triśaṅku, Mahodaya)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/trishanku.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa 59-60)
- **Agastya and Lopāmudrā** — Agastya fashions and weds the princess Lopāmudrā; at her condition he gathers wealth, and they beget the Veda-chanting son Dṛḍhasyu _(actors: Agastya, Lopāmudrā, Dṛḍhasyu)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/agastya.md) — (Mahābhārata Vana Parva; Ṛgveda 1.179)
- **Ajigarta binds and offers to butcher his own son** — After the four priests refuse to bind the boy, Ajigarta binds Sunahshepa for more cattle and offers to slaughter him for yet more, drunk on the promised cows _(actors: Ajigarta, Sunahshepa, Vishvamitra, Jamadagni, Vasishtha)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/sunahshepa.md) — (Aitareya Brahmana 7.16)
- **Śatrughna Slays Lavaṇa and Founds Mathurā** — Rama's brother Shatrughna kills the demon Lavana and founds Mathura on the site of the older Madhuvana _(actors: Shatrughna, Lavana)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/sapta-puri-and-sacred-cities.md) — (Ramayana tradition)
- **Bali Subdued by Vāmana (Trivikrama)** — The dharma-keeping asura-emperor Bali, having conquered the three worlds, is begged three paces of land by Viṣṇu as the dwarf Vāmana, who grows to Trivikrama, strides over creation and pushes Bali to Pātāla while blessing him as a future Indra _(actors: Bali, Viṣṇu (Vāmana/Trivikrama))_ → [details](08-beings-and-bestiary/asura-wars-and-roster.md) — (Bhāgavata Purāṇa 8.15-23)
- **Bhagiratha's penance brings Ganga down** — After three generations fail, King Bhagiratha performs a thousand years of tapas; Brahma grants Ganga's descent but warns only Shiva can bear her fall _(actors: Bhagiratha, Brahma, Ganga)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/ganga.md) — (Ramayana, Bala Kanda 42-43)
- **Breaking of Shiva's Bow** — Rama breaks the bow of Shiva at Janaka's court, winning the contest that qualifies him to marry Sita _(actors: Rama, Janaka)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/README.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda)
- **Fall of the rākṣasa champions and Prahasta** — In successive sorties Rāvaṇa's commanders Dhūmrākṣa, Akampana, Vajradaṃṣṭra, and the chief general Prahasta are slain by Hanumān, Aṅgada, and Nīla _(actors: Hanumān, Aṅgada, Nīla, Prahasta)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/6-yuddha-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Yuddha Kāṇḍa 51–58)
- **Gandharvas steal the rams and break the condition** — The Gandharvas steal Urvaśī's rams by night; Purūravas leaps up naked in pursuit and a lightning-flash reveals him, breaking the taboo, so Urvaśī vanishes _(actors: Purūravas, Urvaśī, Gandharvas)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/pururavas-urvashi.md) — (Shatapatha Brahmana XI.5.1; Vishnu Purana IV.6; Bhagavata Purana IX.14)
- **Hanuman brokers the Rama-Sugriva alliance** — Serving Sugriva, Hanuman first meets Rama and Lakshmana and brokers their alliance, impressing Rama with his flawless speech _(actors: Hanuman, Rama, Lakshmana, Sugriva)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/hanuman.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Kishkindha Kanda 3-4)
- **Hanumān finds Sītā in the Aśoka grove** — After searching Laṅkā's mansions in vain, Hanumān spots the wasted, sorrowful Sītā guarded by rākṣasīs in the Aśoka-vana _(actors: Hanumān, Sītā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/5-sundara-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Sundara Kāṇḍa 14–15)
- **Hariścandra vindicated and son revived** — The gods reveal the ordeal as a test Hariścandra passed without a lie; Rohitāśva is revived, the family and kingdom restored, and heaven won and shared with his people _(actors: Hariścandra, Indra, Yama/Dharma, Viśvāmitra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/hariscandra.md) — (Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa 8)
- **Indra seduces Ahalya and is cursed** — Indra takes sage Gautama's form to lie with Ahalya; the returning sage curses Indra (losing his testicles or bearing a thousand marks that become eyes, hence Sahasraksha) _(actors: Indra, Ahalya, Gautama)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/indra.md) — (Ramayana, Bala Kanda; Brahma Purana)
- **Jaṭāyu pledges to guard Sītā** — On the way to Pañcavaṭī the family meets the aged vulture-king Jaṭāyu, friend of Daśaratha, who pledges to protect Sītā in the brothers' absence _(actors: Jaṭāyu, Rāma)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/3-aranya-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Araṇya Kāṇḍa 14)
- **Kaikeyī's boons and Rāma's exile** — On the eve of his coronation Kaikeyī invokes two boons sending Rāma into 14-year exile and Bharata to the throne; Rāma departs with Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa _(actors: Kaikeyī, Mantharā, Rāma, Sītā, Lakṣmaṇa, Bharata)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/smriti-itihasa-epics.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa 2 (Ayodhyā Kāṇḍa))
- **Kubera founds Alaka** — Dispossessed of Lanka, Kubera builds his magnificent new capital Alakapuri in the Himalayas near Kailasa, the archetypal city of inexhaustible riches _(actors: Kubera)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/kubera.md) — (Ramayana; Meghaduta)
- **Marriage of Rishyashringa to Shanta** — The grateful Lomapada gives his daughter Shanta (originally Dasharatha's daughter) to Rishyashringa, turning the forest-celibate into a householder, and pacifies the wrathful Vibhandaka _(actors: Lomapada, Shanta, Rishyashringa, Vibhandaka)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishyashringa.md) — (Mahabharata, Vana-parva ~113)
- **Mutilation of Śūrpaṇakhā** — When the rākṣasī Śūrpaṇakhā lunges at Sītā, Rāma orders Lakṣmaṇa to disfigure her; he cuts off her nose (and ears), the immediate spark of the war _(actors: Lakṣmaṇa, Śūrpaṇakhā, Rāma)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/lakshmana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Araṇya-kāṇḍa)
- **Paraśurāma slays Kārtavīrya and the kṣatriyas** — The axe-bearing avatāra Paraśurāma, after the Kāmadhenu theft and his father Jamadagni's death, slays the thousand-armed Kārtavīrya Arjuna and vows to clear the earth of kṣatriyas twenty-one times _(actors: Paraśurāma, Jamadagni, Reṇukā, Kārtavīrya Arjuna)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/puranas/brahmanda-purana.md) — (Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa (Paraśurāma cycle))
- **Rama crowns Vibhishana king of Lanka** — After Ravana's fall Rama crowns the defector Vibhishana king of Lanka and grants him life lasting to the Kalpa's end _(actors: Rama, Vibhishana)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/the-chiranjivis.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana Yuddha Kanda)
- **Rama's Darbha-Sayanam at Tirupullani** — At the Sethu site of Tirupullani, Rama performs darbha-sayanam (lying on sacred grass) before the crossing to Lanka _(actors: Rama)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/108-divya-desams.md) — (Ramayana / sthala-purana)
- **Rama's Triumphant Return to Ayodhya** — Rama returns to Ayodhya after exile and the war, the prototype celebration of Dipavali _(actors: Rama)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/ayodhya.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha-kanda)
- **Rāma's twin proofs of strength** — To convince the doubting Sugrīva, Rāma flicks Dundubhi's skeleton ten yojanas with his toe and splits seven sāla trees with a single arrow _(actors: Rāma, Sugrīva)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/sugriva-and-vali.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Kiṣkindhā-kāṇḍa)
- **Rāvaṇa Lifts Mount Kailāsa** — The demon-king Ravana tries to uproot Kailasa; Shiva pins it with his toe crushing Ravana, who then composes the Shiva-tandava-stotra _(actors: Ravana, Shiva)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/meru-kailash-and-cosmic-mountains.md) — (Ramayana Uttara-kanda; Shiva Purana)
- **Rāvaṇa's digvijaya and Indrajit's victory over Indra** — Rāvaṇa subdues yakṣas, gandharvas, nāgas, and kings, even defeating Yama, while his son Meghanāda conquers Indra and earns the name Indrajit _(actors: Rāvaṇa, Meghanāda/Indrajit, Yama, Indra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/ravana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Uttara-kāṇḍa)
- **Sagara's Aśvamedha and the theft of the horse** — Indra steals the horse of King Sagara's Aśvamedha, leading to the destruction of his 60,000 sons and ultimately framing the descent of the Gaṅgā _(actors: Sagara, Indra, Sagara's 60,000 sons)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/yajnas-and-vedic-rituals.md) — (Ramayana; Bhagavata Purana 9)
- **Shiva-Gita: Shiva instructs Rama and grants the Pashupata weapon** — In a Shaiva counterpart to the Bhagavad Gita, Shiva instructs Rama in self-knowledge and grants him the pashupata weapon _(actors: Shiva, Rama)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/puranas/padma-purana.md) — (Padma Purana (Uttara Khanda, Shiva-Gita))
- **Slaughter of Vasiṣṭha's hundred sons** — In the Mahābhārata telling Viśvāmitra engineers the death of Vasiṣṭha's hundred sons via the cannibal rākṣasa Kalmāṣapāda _(actors: Viśvāmitra, Vasiṣṭha, Śakti, Kalmāṣapāda)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vishwamitra-vasishtha.md) — (Mahābhārata Ādi Parva, Vasiṣṭha upākhyāna)
- **Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa insist on accompanying Rāma** — Sītā refuses to be left behind, declaring a wife's place is at her husband's side, and Lakṣmaṇa is granted leave to follow as servant-protector _(actors: Sītā, Lakṣmaṇa, Rāma)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/2-ayodhya-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Ayodhyā Kāṇḍa 26–31)
- **Sugrīva enthroned, Aṅgada made heir** — Lakṣmaṇa enters Kiṣkindhā and consecrates Sugrīva king of the vānaras, with Vāli's son Aṅgada installed as crown prince _(actors: Sugrīva, Aṅgada, Lakṣmaṇa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/4-kishkindha-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Kiṣkindhā Kāṇḍa 25–26)
- **The golden deer lures Rāma away** — Mārīca takes the form of a dazzling golden deer at Rāvaṇa's order; the enchanted Sītā begs Rāma to capture it, drawing him from the hermitage _(actors: Sītā, Mārīca, Rāma)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/sita.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Araṇya Kāṇḍa)
- **The pāyasa distributed to the queens** — A divine being rises from the sacrificial fire bearing pāyasa for the queens; its distribution gives Sumitrā two sons _(actors: Daśaratha, Kausalyā, Kaikeyī, Sumitrā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/1-bala-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Bāla Kāṇḍa 16)
- **The trials of Harishchandra** — The truthful Ikshvaku king Harishchandra is stripped of kingdom, wife and son to honor a debt to Vishvamitra and becomes a cremation-ground slave, yet never lies and is finally restored to heaven _(actors: Harishchandra, Vishvamitra, Shaivya, his son)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/puranas/markandeya-purana.md) — (Markandeya Purana (chs. 7-8))
- **Triśaṅku's ascent and Indra's kick** — By Viśvāmitra's tapas Triśaṅku rises bodily to heaven, but Indra and the devas kick him back down head-first _(actors: Triśaṅku, Viśvāmitra, Indra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/trishanku.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa 60)
- **Śukra's Warning, Curse, and the Blinded Eye** — Recognizing Viṣṇu, Śukra forbids the gift and curses Bali; lodging in the kamaṇḍalu spout to block the consecration-water, he is pierced in one eye by Vāmana's kuśa-grass, becoming one-eyed _(actors: Śukrācārya, Bali, Vāmana)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vamana-bali.md) — (Bhāgavata Purāṇa 8.19–8.20)
- **Vamana's three strides reclaiming the worlds from Bali** — The dwarf avatara takes three strides to reclaim the worlds from the asura king Bali, embedded in the Matsya Purana's deva-asura material _(actors: Vishnu (Vamana), Bali)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/puranas/matsya-purana.md) — (Matsya Purana)
- **Vasiṣṭha's grief and Parāśara's restrained vengeance** — Bereaved Vasiṣṭha survives repeated suicide attempts and dissuades grandson Parāśara from a world-destroying revenge sacrifice _(actors: Vasiṣṭha, Parāśara)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vishwamitra-vasishtha.md) — (Mahābhārata Ādi Parva)
- **Vibhīṣaṇa performs Rāvaṇa's last rites** — At first refusing to perform funeral rites for the brother who wronged him, Vibhīṣaṇa is persuaded by Rāma that enmity ends at death and performs the obsequies _(actors: Vibhīṣaṇa, Rāma, Rāvaṇa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/vibhishana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Yuddha Kāṇḍa)
- **Vishvamitra performs the ascent yajna and curses the boycotters** — Vishvamitra agrees to send Trishanku bodily to heaven and curses Vasishtha's sons and Mahodaya to ash/chandala rebirth when they refuse to attend _(actors: Vishvamitra, Trishanku, Mahodaya)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/trishanku.md) — (Ramayana Bala Kanda 59-60)
- **Viśvāmitra adopts Sunaḥśepa as Devarāta** — Hotṛ-priest Viśvāmitra adopts the rescued boy as eldest son Devarāta; fifty of his own sons refuse and are cursed to become border peoples _(actors: Viśvāmitra, Sunaḥśepa/Devarāta)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/sunahshepa.md) — (Aitareya Brāhmaṇa 7.17-18)
- **Viśvāmitra adopts Śunaḥśepa and curses his sons** — Viśvāmitra adopts Śunaḥśepa as eldest son, renaming him Devarāta, and curses the fifty of his own sons who refuse the foundling to become outcastes — an aetiology of border tribes _(actors: Viśvāmitra, Śunaḥśepa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/hariscandra.md) — (Aitareya Brāhmaṇa 7.17–18)
- **Vālmīki composes the Rāmāyaṇa and teaches it to the twins** — The ādi-kavi composes the 24,000-śloka Rāmāyaṇa (śoka turned to śloka) and trains the twins to chant it, making the hero's unrecognised sons its first reciters _(actors: Vālmīki, Lava, Kuśa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/uttara-ramayana-lava-kusha.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Uttara Kāṇḍa 71, 93)
- **Vāmana reclaims the three worlds** — Viṣṇu as the dwarf Vāmana reclaims the three worlds from the asura king Bali in three strides _(actors: Vāmana, Bali)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/trimurti-and-tridevi.md) — (Bhāgavata Purāṇa)
- **Śabalā's Army vs. Viśvāmitra** — When King Viśvāmitra tries to seize Vasiṣṭha's cow Śabalā by force, she generates whole foreign armies from her body that rout his forces _(actors: Śabalā, Viśvāmitra, Vasiṣṭha)_ → [details](08-beings-and-bestiary/kamadhenu-and-divine-cattle.md) — (Rāmāyaṇa, Bāla-kāṇḍa ch. 54-55)
- **Agastya equips Rāma in the South** — At his Daṇḍaka hermitage Agastya gifts Rāma the bow of Viṣṇu and divine arms, and later teaches him the Āditya-Hṛdayam before slaying Rāvaṇa _(actors: Agastya, Rāma)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/agastya.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Araṇya & Yuddha Kāṇḍas)
- **Agastya narrates the condensed Rāmāyaṇa** — The sage Agastya recounts a compressed Rāma-carita — Rāma's birth, exile, Sītā's abduction by Rāvaṇa, the alliance with Sugrīva and Hanumān, the war at Laṅkā, and the return _(actors: Agastya, Rāma, Sītā, Rāvaṇa, Hanumān, Sugrīva)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/puranas/agni-purana.md) — (Agni Purāṇa (condensed Rāmāyaṇa))
- **Bali Grants the Gift Despite the Warning** — Invoking Prahlāda and the supreme dharma of truth, Bali refuses to retract his word, accepts Śukra's curse, and pours the water to seal the three paces _(actors: Bali, Vindhyāvali, Vāmana, Śukrācārya)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vamana-bali.md) — (Bhāgavata Purāṇa 8.20)
- **Brahmā orders the gods to father the vānaras** — Brahmā commands the gods to beget mighty vānaras (Vālin, Sugrīva, Hanumān, Nala) as Rāma's future army _(actors: Brahmā, Devas)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/1-bala-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Bāla Kāṇḍa 17)
- **Creation of the counter-heaven (Triśaṅku-svarga)** — Enraged Viśvāmitra builds a parallel southern heaven with new stars and a second Indra; the gods relent, fixing Triśaṅku head-down as a constellation _(actors: Viśvāmitra, Triśaṅku, Brahmā, Indra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/trishanku.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa 60)
- **Death of Kumbhakarṇa** — Roused from his cursed long sleep, the colossal Kumbhakarṇa devours and scatters vānaras until Rāma severs his limbs and head with celestial arrows _(actors: Rāma, Kumbhakarṇa, Rāvaṇa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/6-yuddha-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Yuddha Kāṇḍa 60–67)
- **Departure from Ayodhyā into exile** — Donning bark garments, Rāma, Sītā, and Lakṣmaṇa leave on Sumantra's chariot as the grieving city follows _(actors: Rāma, Sītā, Lakṣmaṇa, Sumantra)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/2-ayodhya-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Ayodhyā Kāṇḍa 37–40)
- **Gaṅgādhara — descent of Gaṅgā** — Śiva catches the celestial Gaṅgā in his matted locks to break her world-shattering fall, brought down by Bhagīratha's penance to redeem Sagara's 60,000 sons _(actors: Śiva, Gaṅgā, Bhagīratha)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/shiva-myth-cycle.md) — (Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa, Bhāgavata Purāṇa, Skanda Purāṇa)
- **Ganesha breaks his tusk against Parashurama** — In a variant, Ganesha blocks Parashurama at Kailasa and takes Shiva's axe on his tusk out of reverence, breaking it _(actors: Ganesha, Parashurama)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/ganesha-and-kartikeya.md) — (Brahmavaivarta Purana)
- **Hanuman leaps the ocean to Lanka** — Reminded of his powers by Jambavan, Hanuman expands to colossal size and bounds across the ocean to Lanka, defeating Surasa and slaying Simhika en route _(actors: Hanuman, Jambavan, Surasa, Simhika)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/hanuman.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Sundara Kanda 1)
- **Hariscandra the truthful** — Ikshvaku king Hariscandra surrenders kingdom, wife, and son to honor a debt to Vishvamitra, is tested to the extreme, and elevated to heaven _(actors: Hariscandra, Vishvamitra, Shaivya, Rohitashva)_ → [details](01-manvantaras/manvantara-07-vaivasvata/mahayuga-28-current/02-treta-yuga.md) — (Markandeya Purana, Aitareya Brahmana, Devi Bhagavata)
- **Lakṣmaṇa recalls Sugrīva to his vow** — When Sugrīva lapses into pleasure and forgets his oath, an enraged Lakṣmaṇa is sent to Kiṣkindhā; Tārā's diplomacy rouses Sugrīva to mobilize the search _(actors: Lakṣmaṇa, Sugrīva, Tārā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/4-kishkindha-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Kiṣkindhā Kāṇḍa 30–33)
- **Maināka Rises to Aid Hanumān** — As Hanuman leaps the ocean to Lanka, Mainaka rises from the sea to offer him rest as a debt repaid to Vayu; Hanuman touches it courteously and flies on _(actors: Mainaka, Hanuman)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/meru-kailash-and-cosmic-mountains.md) — (Ramayana Sundara-kanda)
- **Marriage of Rama and Sita** — Having broken Shiva's bow, Rama marries Sita, princess of Mithila _(actors: Rama, Sita, Janaka)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/README.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda)
- **Menakā breaks Viśvāmitra's tapas; birth of Śakuntalā** — Indra sends apsarā Menakā to seduce Viśvāmitra; they live together ten years and beget Śakuntalā, future mother of Bharata _(actors: Viśvāmitra, Menakā, Indra, Śakuntalā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/vishwamitra-vasishtha.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Bāla Kāṇḍa 63; Mahābhārata Ādi Parva)
- **Rama's Jala-Samadhi into the Sarayu** — At his reign's close Rama appoints Kusha and Lava, walks into the Sarayu at Gopratara, takes his Vaishnava form and ascends to Vaikuntha _(actors: Rama, Kusha, Lava)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/ayodhya.md) — (Valmiki Ramayana, Uttara-kanda)
- **Rambhā assaulted by Rāvaṇa and Nalakūbara's curse** — Rāvaṇa assaults Rambhā despite her protests, prompting Nalakūbara to curse that Rāvaṇa's head would burst into seven pieces if he ever forced a woman — the curse that later protected Sītā _(actors: Rambhā, Rāvaṇa, Nalakūbara)_ → [details](08-beings-and-bestiary/apsaras.md) — (Rāmāyaṇa Uttara Kāṇḍa)
- **Ravana steals the Pushpaka** — Ravana assaults Kubera again and carries off the self-willed flying palace-chariot Pushpaka _(actors: Ravana, Kubera)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/kubera.md) — (Mahabharata Ramopakhyana; Ramayana)
- **Reunion at the swan-lake and the annual-night boon** — Wandering and lamenting, Purūravas finds Urvaśī among apsarās as aquatic birds at Anyataḥplakṣā; she grants him one night a year and the promise of a son _(actors: Purūravas, Urvaśī)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/pururavas-urvashi.md) — (Shatapatha Brahmana XI.5.1)
- **Rāma instructs Hanumān on the 108 Upaniṣads** — In the Muktikā Upaniṣad, Rāma teaches Hanumān that liberation comes from studying the 108 Upaniṣads and enumerates them _(actors: Rāma, Hanumān)_ → [details](90-literature-corpus/shruti-vedas-and-upanishads.md) — (Muktikā Upaniṣad)
- **Rāma's Aśvamedha with the golden Sītā** — Refusing to remarry, Rāma performs the imperial horse-sacrifice using a golden image of Sītā in the wife's ritual seat _(actors: Rāma)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/uttara-ramayana-lava-kusha.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa Uttara Kāṇḍa 91)
- **Rāma's Śrāddha for Daśaratha at Gayā** — Rāma, Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa come to Gayā to perform śrāddha for Daśaratha; while the men bathe, the ancestor's hand appears demanding the piṇḍa _(actors: Rāma, Sītā, Lakṣmaṇa, Daśaratha)_ → [details](06-sacred-geography/gaya-pitru-tirtha.md) — (local sthala-purana (Ramayana-derived))
- **Rāvaṇa lifts Mount Kailāsa and receives Candrahāsa** — Affronted at Kailāsa, Rāvaṇa tries to uproot the mountain; Śiva pins him with a toe, and after Rāvaṇa sings his praises for a thousand years Śiva releases him and grants the sword Candrahāsa _(actors: Rāvaṇa, Śiva, Nandī)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/ravana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Uttara-kāṇḍa)
- **Rāvaṇa threatens Sītā with two months** — Rāvaṇa courts Sītā with promises of queenship; she rejects him utterly, and he gives her two months to relent or be killed _(actors: Rāvaṇa, Sītā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/ramayana/5-sundara-kanda.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Sundara Kāṇḍa 18–23)
- **Sanatkumara's prophecy of Rishyashringa** — The sage Sanatkumara foretold that Vibhandaka's son Rishyashringa would come to Anga, end its drought, marry Shanta, and later enable an Ikshvaku king to obtain sons _(actors: Sanatkumara)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/rishyashringa.md) — (Ramayana (Valmiki), Bala-kanda ~9)
- **Second demonic birth: Ravana and Kumbhakarna slain** — The cursed pair are reborn as the rakshasa brothers Ravana and Kumbhakarna of Lanka, both slain by the single avatara Rama in Treta-yuga _(actors: Ravana, Kumbhakarna, Rama, Sita)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/jaya-vijaya.md) — (Bhagavata Purana 7.1, 7.10; Valmiki Ramayana)
- **Shiva catches Ganga in his locks** — Shiva traps the proud, plunging Ganga entirely in his matted hair, then releases her in streams to earth, becoming Gangadhara _(actors: Shiva, Ganga, Bhagiratha)_ → [details](02-deities-and-cosmic-hierarchy/ganga.md) — (Ramayana, Bala Kanda 43-44)
- **Slaughter of Khara, Dūṣaṇa and 14,000 rākṣasas at Janasthāna** — Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa annihilate Khara, Dūṣaṇa, and 14,000 rākṣasas at Janasthāna, driving Rāvaṇa to plot Sītā's abduction _(actors: Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa, Khara, Dūṣaṇa)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/lakshmana.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Araṇya-kāṇḍa)
- **Sītā casts down her jewels as a trail** — Borne off by Rāvaṇa, Sītā drops her jewels to leave a trail later recovered with the vānaras, pointing the search toward Laṅkā _(actors: Sītā)_ → [details](04-deep-dives/characters/sita.md) — (Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Araṇya/Kiṣkindhā Kāṇḍa)
